answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. A inlet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the sparrow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The ocean of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
